title: Gates of hell will open for you’: Iran rejects Trump’s ‘helpless’ 48-hour ultimatum to reopen Strait of Hormuz
byline: Iran on Saturday rejected US President Donald Trump’s ‘48-hour ultimatum’, in which he threatened to destroy the nation’s essential infrastructure if a deal is not reached within the stipulated time.

title: Sri Lanka postpones VAT on digital services until July 1
byline: The government has further postponed the implementation of an 18% Value Added Tax (VAT) on digital services supplied by non-resident providers through electronic platforms until July 1, according to a circular issued by the Inland Revenue Department.

title: GMOA launches island-wide token strike today
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has announced that its island-wide token strike will commence today (05) at 08.00 a.m., following a decision taken at its Executive Council meeting held yesterday.

title: Northern railway line train services to resume from April 9
byline: The Railways Department has announced that train services along the Northern Railway Line will resume from April 9, following the completion of reconstruction work on sections damaged by Cyclone Ditwah.

title: Trump warns Iran has 48 hours to reopen Strait of Hormuz
byline: US President Donald Trump recalls his twice-delayed threat to bomb Iran’s energy sites if it doesn’t open the Strait of Hormuz, which expires on Monday.

title: Iran claims it shot down US C-130 support aircraft in Isfahan
byline: Iran claimed on Sunday that it shot down a US C-130 support aircraft in the southern area of Isfahan.

title: Silence over ‘Ondesterone’ vaccine raises suspicion – Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa
byline: Specialist Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa has alleged that the continued silence of health authorities over the controversial “Ondesterone” vaccine, suspected to be linked to several patient deaths, raises serious concerns.

title: Congress alleges Sri Lankan diplomat Ketheeswaran interfered in Tamil Nadu affairs
byline: Sri Lanka’s Deputy Consul General for South India, Ganesanathan Ketheeswaran, has been accused by Pawan Khera, Chairman of the Media and Publicity Department of the All India Congress Committee of interfering in the internal affairs of Tamil Nadu, following his participation in a meeting in Puducherry.

title: Fuel station owners to hold silent protest at CPC tomorrow
byline: The Petroleum Distributors Association (PDA) has announced that fuel station owners across the island will stage a silent protest in front of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) tomorrow (06) at 9.30 a.m., citing several unresolved issues affecting their operations.

title: Iran says several ’enemy flying objects’ destroyed during US pilot rescue mission
byline: Several ’’flying objects’’ ​were destroyed during the U.S. mission ‌to find a stranded airman in Iran, the Revolutionary Guards said ​on Sunday according to ​Tasnim news agency.

title: Sun directly overhead across Sri Lanka
byline: The sun will be directly overhead across Sri Lanka from April 5 to 15, due to its apparent northward movement, said the Department of Meteorology.

title: 12-hour water cut in Padukka tonight
byline: A 12-hour water cut will be imposed in Padukka and surrounding areas from 8.00 pm today till 8.00 am tomorrow, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) said.

title: Two Chinese passengers nabbed at BIA for cigarette smuggling attempt
byline: Two Chinese passengers were arrested by a team of Customs officers at the Bandaranaike International Airport, (BIA), this morning while attempting to smuggle a stock of cigarettes worth Rs. 3.63 million through the “Green Channel” without declaration.

title: Trump confirms rescue of US officer, says ‘we got him’
byline: The US president is now confirming the rescue of the weapons officer who went missing after his F-15E jet was shot down over Iran.

title: Iran executes two men involved in January protests judiciary news outlet says
byline: Iran executed two men convicted of attempting to storm a ​military facility and access an armoury ‌during unrest in January, the Mizan news outlet of its judiciary said on Sunday.

title: US says it has arrested relatives of late Iranian ​general Qasem ​Soleimani
byline: The niece and grand-niece of the deceased commander of the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps, Gen Qasem Soleimani, have been arrested, the US state department has said.

title: Sri Lankan diplomat Ketheeswaran accused of interference in Puducherry election
byline: Sri Lanka’s Deputy Consul General for South India, Ganesanathan Ketheeswaran, has been accused by Pawan Khera, Chairman of the Media and Publicity Department of the All India Congress Committee of interfering in the internal affairs of Puducherry, following his participation in a meeting there.

title: WHO chief raises concerns over US-Israeli attacks on nuclear sites in Iran
byline: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, director-general of the World Health Organisation, has raised the alarm over the safety of nuclear facilities in Iran following US-Israeli strikes close to the Bushehr nuclear power plant.

title: Chinese passenger nabbed at BIA for smuggling protected Kothalahimbutu
byline: A Chinese national attempting to illegally smuggle 48.6 kilograms of Kothalahimbutu out of Sri Lanka has been arrested by Customs officers at the Departure Terminal of Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA).

title: Sri Lanka–China relations commemorative publication launched in Beijing
byline: A commemorative tea table book titled “Sri Lanka - China Relations: Community with a Shared Future” was launched in Beijing, marking 70 years of diplomatic relations between Sri Lanka and China.

title: Government must be protected until objectives of forming it achieved: Tilvin
byline: Claiming that it is not possible to deveolp the country and change the society in a day, the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP) General Secretary Tilvin Silva said today the government must be protected until the objectives of forming the government are achieved.

title: LP Gas prices increased due to global market surge
byline: Due to rising global energy costs linked to the ongoing international conflict, Litro Gas Lanka Company has announced an increase in domestic LP gas prices with effect from midnight today.

title: Trump threatens ’’crazy b***s’’ of Iran and demands reopening ’’f***g strait’’ of Hormuz before Tuesday
byline: The president of the United States, Donald Trump, launched this Sunday his toughest warning to date, loaded with insults, against the authorities of Iran after the blockade of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. He has given them until next Tuesday to reopen the passage or, otherwise, assures that he will order a massive attack against the country’s main infrastructures.

title: Jaffna island teachers lose hardship allowances after school reclassification
byline: Teachers serving in several remote island schools in Jaffna have been deprived of their hardship allowances following a recent school classification revision, prompting urgent appeals for intervention by the Education Ministry.

title: GMOA issues ultimatum to Health Minister
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has issued an ultimatum to Health Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa, granting him until 8.00 a.m. tomorrow (06) to begin discussions to resolve the ongoing doctors’ strike.

title: Iran demands war compensation to reopen Strait of Hormuz: Official
byline: Seyyed Mehdi Tabatabaei, deputy for communications at the Iranian president’s office, has said Iran will open the Strait of Hormuz only after receiving compensation for war damages, paid via a “new legal regime” based on transit fees.

title: LAUGFS gas also raises LPG prices
byline: LAUGFS Gas PLC has announced a revision of domestic LPG cylinder refill prices, effective from midnight today (05), citing prevailing market conditions.
